nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for cellforge.backends that re-exports the LLMBackend protocol and the MockBackend implementation as the public backend API.
nodes.languageNotes: Python package __init__ using __all__ to declare the public re-export surface.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the LLMBackend structural protocol that every cellforge agent backend must satisfy: a name attribute and a complete(system, user, max_tokens) method returning a string.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for structural (duck-typed) subtyping, so real SDK wrappers and test mocks conform without explicit inheritance.

nodes.name: mock.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic, network-free MockBackend that routes on keywords in the user prompt (curate, literature, architecture, train, validate, critique) and returns canned JSON so the full propose-critique-vote agent loop can run in tests and offline demos.
nodes.languageNotes: A @dataclass satisfying the LLMBackend Protocol via structural typing; keyword routing stands in for a real LLM call.

nodes.name: LLMBackend
nodes.summary: Protocol declaring the minimal backend contract used by agents: a name string and a complete(system, user, *, max_tokens=512) -> str method. Real backends (OpenAI, Anthropic, vLLM) and MockBackend all conform to it.

nodes.name: MockBackend
nodes.summary: Dataclass backend whose complete() lowercases the user prompt and returns a fixed JSON string keyed on role keywords (curation/QC stats, literature priors, model architecture, training recipe, validation metrics, critique), falling back to a generic mock note.
